name: jinglebox
description: Plays sounds from your Jinglebox workspace on Claude Code events: answer waiting, question waiting, long turn, tests passed or failed, merge request created

workspace.title: Jinglebox workspace slug
workspace.description: The workspace the sounds come from; empty to pick it with /jinglebox workspace

mcp_server.title: Jinglebox MCP server name
mcp_server.description: The name of the Jinglebox MCP server, as /mcp lists it

long_turn_seconds.title: Long turn threshold (seconds)
long_turn_seconds.description: A turn longer than this plays the long-turn sound instead of the turn-done one

random_max_seconds.title: Random sounds maximum length (seconds)
random_max_seconds.description: A random pick only takes sounds this short or shorter
